tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Explain how to start a gleanyard collection project without installing anything (template repo, Claude Code on the web, Codespaces).

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search the public gleanyard source registry for recipes: sources that already work, with a fixture, a terms review and a health count. Empty query lists all.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Read one registry recipe: its index entry, source file, recipe notes and terms evidence, and the command that installs it.

tools.name: get_schema
tools.description: Read a record schema the registry's recipes are written for, e.g. family-event.

tools.name: project_status
tools.description: Read status.json of a public gleanyard project on GitHub: each source's health, record count, warnings and last success.

tools.name: search_records
tools.description: Search the rights-filtered export of a public gleanyard project (exports/records.jsonl, or the path its dataherb.json names) by text, optionally for one source.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Records added, changed or removed lately in a public gleanyard project, newest first, from its change feed (exports/changes.json).
